test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

The children said to the nurse, “Reema slipped and fell from the stairs.”

options.text: The children told the nurse Reema has slipped and fallen from the stairs.
The children told the nurse that Reema had slipped and fallen from the stairs.
The children told to the nurse that Reema slipped and fallen from the stairs.
The children told the nurse that Reema slipped and fell from the stairs.

solution:
​​The correct answer is **'The children told the nurse that Reema had slipped and fallen from the stairs.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is an assertive sentence.
 
• 
 While changing the narration of an assertive sentence, these steps need to be followed - 

 
 
• The **reporting verb said** changes to **told**. ( This is because we use **told **when we normally say who is spoken to which in this case is *the **nurse*.)
 
• The conjunction 'that' is used in place of commas and inverted commas. 
 
• The verb slipped **and fell** expresses the **simple past tense form.**
 
• The **simple past tense form** is changed to past perfect tense *had slipped and fallen.*
 
 
 
• Eventually, we will get the final sentence- The children told the nurse that Reema had slipped and fallen from the stairs.
